newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: $142 mln Colombian coal port approved.
newsitem.headline: $142 mln Colombian coal port approved.

text.p: Colombia approved a $142 million deep water port facility Friday to be built with private funds near the Caribbean city of Barranquilla, a government spokesman said.

The port, to be named "Bocas de Ceniza", will be primarily used for coal exports brought up the central Magdalena River from central Boyaca province and northern Cesar and Santander provinces, said Nicanor Florez, head of the investors group funding the project.
The port will be built in two phases starting in the first quarter of 1998 and is due to be completed within a year.
